info.title: 0xRadar API
info.description:
Multi-chain wallet intelligence platform — portfolio aggregation, DeFi position monitoring, sweep cost calculation, and token risk scoring across 8 EVM chains + Solana.

**Features:**
- Real-time multi-chain balance aggregation (parallel `asyncio` fetch)
- Token metadata enrichment (symbol, name, decimals, logo)
- CoinGecko USD price integration
- Sweep consolidation cost calculator (unique differentiator vs DeBank/Zerion)
- DeFi position aggregation (Aave v3, HyperLend, Sentiment v2, Uniswap v3, Compound v3)
- Token risk scoring with GoPlus Security integration
- Magic link authentication (anti-enumeration)
- API key management, usage stats, rate limit monitoring
- Crypto payment checkout (NOWPayments) — unauthenticated or authenticated
- Solana balance support via Helius RPC

**Authentication:** Optional `X-API-Key` header for higher rate limits. Pro tier required for admin endpoints. Magic link auth for dashboard access.

get.summary: Get wallet balances on a single chain
get.description:
Fetches native + ERC-20 token balances for an address on a specific chain. Includes USD values when `include_prices=true`. Results are cached for 5 minutes.

**EVM chains:** Uses standard RPC (balanceOf + native).
**Solana (`chain=solana`):** Uses Helius RPC and returns a Solana-native schema (SPL tokens instead of ERC-20). Solana addresses are base58-encoded (e.g., `7EcD...`).

**Free tier:** max 10 tokens returned. **Dev/Pro:** up to 200.

get.description:
Fetches wallet balances across multiple chains in parallel. Returns aggregated totals and per-chain breakdowns. Results are cached for 5 minutes.

**Free tier:** max 3 chains per request. **Dev/Pro:** up to 20 chains. Supports all EVM chains and Solana (via Helius RPC).

parameters.name: chains
parameters.description: Comma-separated chain IDs. Default: all supported chains. Free tier limits to 3.

parameters.name: include_prices
parameters.description: Whether to include USD price and value calculations

get.description:
Estimates the gas cost to sweep/consolidate all assets from a wallet across specified chains to a target chain. Analyzes each chain's token count, estimates gas costs, and provides a profitability recommendation.

**Unique differentiator:** DeBank, Zerion, and other portfolio trackers do not offer sweep cost calculation.

parameters.name: chains
parameters.description: Comma-separated chain IDs to evaluate. Default: all supported chains.

200.description: Sweep cost summary with profitability analysis

summary.recommendation_reason: Net gain of $11750.40 exceeds gas costs

400.description: Invalid address or unsupported target chain

post.description:
Sends a one-time magic link to the provided email address. The link contains a short-lived JWT token for passwordless authentication. **Always returns 200** even for unknown emails — this prevents email enumeration attacks.

Token expiry: 15 minutes. User accounts are created on first successful login (auto-provisioning).

200.description: Magic link sent (or silently ignored for unknown emails — anti-enumeration)

post.description:
Validates a magic link token and returns a session JWT. The token is **one-time use** — it is deleted after successful verification. If the email doesn't have an account yet, one is created automatically.

Use the returned `token` as `X-API-Key` header for authenticated endpoints.

post.description:
Creates a NOWPayments invoice for the authenticated user to upgrade their plan. Returns payment details including the deposit address and amount.

**Plans:**
- `pro_monthly` — Pro tier, renewed monthly
- `pro_yearly` — Pro tier, renewed yearly (discounted)
- `lifetime` — Pro tier, one-time payment for lifetime access

**Default coin:** ETH. Payment is tracked via the NOWPayments IPN webhook.

Missing X-API-Key header or api_key query param

delete.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account and all associated data (API keys, usage stats, payment history). This action is irreversible and fulfills GDPR right-to-erasure requirements.

Creates a NOWPayments invoice for the given email address — no authentication required. This allows users to purchase API access before creating an account.

**Plans:** pro_monthly, pro_yearly, lifetime.

An account is automatically provisioned when the payment is confirmed via IPN webhook.

get.description:
Aggregates DeFi positions across multiple protocols in parallel for a given wallet address. Queries lending protocols (Aave v3, HyperLend, Sentiment v2, Compound v3) and LP positions (Uniswap v3). Returns collateral, debt, health factors, and LP value.

Results are cached for 60 seconds. Only EVM addresses are supported (no Solana for positions).

Performs a comprehensive security analysis of an ERC-20 token contract using GoPlus Security. Evaluates signals including honeypot detection, buy/sell tax, proxy risk, liquidity, owner privileges, and more.

**Not supported on hyperevm or solana.** Currently only EVM-compatible chains with Etherscan-style explorers are supported.

post.description:
Receives Instant Payment Notifications (IPN) from NOWPayments. Validates the HMAC-SHA512 signature from the `x-nowpayments-sig` header before processing.

On confirmed payment: upgrades the user's tier, sends receipt email, activates subscription.

**IPN security:** Signature is verified against NOWPayments IPN secret key. Unverified requests are silently rejected with 200 to prevent retry storms.

parameters.description: HMAC-SHA512 signature of the request body (from NOWPayments IPN)
